coin.title: Medal World Money Fair 2026 - Swissmint
coin.description: At the World Money Fair 2026, which took place in Berlin from January 29 to 31, 2026, all 600 pieces of the medal were successfully sold. On each day of the fair, 200 medals were offered for sale.
coin.specsText:
At the World Money Fair 2026, which took place in Berlin from January 29 to 31, 2026, all 600 pieces of the medal were successfully sold. On each day of the fair, 200 medals were offered for sale. Silver Medal World Money Fair 2026 Silver medal from Swissmint minted exclusively for the 2026 World Money Fair. Limited to 600 pieces and numbered. English Deutsch Français Italiano Federal Mint Swissmint Purchase coins Purchase coins Contact Menu Purchase coins Purchase coins Special coins Special coinsAgendaVideos MagazineCompany SwissmintGuided tour Contact Silver Medal World Money Fair 2026 At the World Money Fair 2026, which took place in Berlin from January 29 to 31, 2026, all 600 pieces of the medal were successfully sold. On each day of the fair, 200 medals were offered for sale. Learn more about the World Money FairA remarkable medalThis remarkable medal was minted in 999 silver, weighs 20 grams and has a high relief of 0.75 mm, three times higher than the usual standard of 0.25 mm. This exceptional minting quality gives the motif impressive depth. In addition, the medal bears an inscription on the edge in three national languages – + SUISSE + + SCHWEIZ + + SVIZZERA + – separated by Swiss crosses that emphasise its official and Swiss character. Each piece is also marked directly on the medal with an individual lasered number.
